description: This file contains unit tests for command-related functionalities in the Mattermost server, including creating, archiving, listing, modifying, moving, and showing commands, with extensive use of mock expectations and test cases.

methods.name: TestCommandCreateCmd
methods.description: Unit test for creating commands with various scenarios including success, missing team, invalid trigger, and failure cases.

methods.name: TestArchiveCommandCmd
methods.description: Unit test for archiving (deleting) commands, covering success, failure, and error response scenarios.

methods.name: TestCommandListCmdF
methods.description: Unit test for listing commands across all teams or specific team, including error handling.

methods.name: TestCommandModifyCmd
methods.description: Unit test for modifying existing commands, including success, nonexistent command, invalid user, and trigger validation errors.

methods.name: TestCommandMoveCmd
methods.description: Unit test for moving commands between teams by ID, including success, invalid team, and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestCommandShowCmd
methods.description: Unit test for displaying commands by ID or team:trigger, including not found and path traversal checks.
